name: Sample Customer
review: Replace these with real reviews. A specific, concrete story beats a generic 'great service' every time — mention what the customer came in for and how it went.

name: Another Happy Client
review: Two or three sentences is the sweet spot. Keep the customer's own voice; lightly trim for length. A first name and last initial reads as authentic.

name: A. Regular
review: If you collect reviews on Google or Facebook, add a `link` field to each entry and the card shows a 'Read more' link out to the original.

name: First-time Visitor
review: Aim for four to six reviews so the carousel has something to scroll. They rotate horizontally with swipe/scroll-snap and are fully keyboard accessible.
